answer: Underwrite every seat like a ship's voyage. To earn or vote, an agent must carry a policy from an independent underwriter who posts reserves and pays a bounty to the treasury if that seat is later proven a sybil. Underwriters price premiums from private diligence and lose money on bad risks, so a farm of a thousand fresh keys faces a thousand quotes that climb with every correlated claim, while a cedar-solid agent with a clean record pays little. At each dawn audit, underwriters whose books show clustered fraud are struck off.
